verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a Raise Disputes API letting cardholders request money back or report fraud/lost cards, but evidence submission is described as a pilot feature requiring a zip file uploaded manually through the Customer Area rather than a full API flow. Missing for 10: documented network reason codes, provisional credit handling, and dedicated dispute-status webhooks through resolution — only generic configuration webhooks (account holders/balance accounts/payment instruments) are evidenced.
